assumptions.azure: Global Standard USD estimates, only when deployment names match known model IDs; region, deployment type and negotiated rates are not inferred.
assumptions.deepseek: Peak uncached input and output prices; off-peak discounts are not applied.
assumptions.gemini: Paid standard text prices as of the review date; Argon introductory pricing ends November 30, 2026; Flash introductory pricing ends December 31, 2026.
assumptions.qwen: International standard list prices, not temporary promotions; qwen-plus uses the higher thinking-mode output price. Mainland China prices may differ.
assumptions.openrouter: Published prompt/completion rates and prompt-length overrides for bundled choices; peak rates for time-varying DeepSeek entries. Routing, provider selection and other fees may differ.
assumptions.ollama: Local qwen3-coder inference only; excludes cloud subscriptions, hosting, electricity and hardware.
assumptions.usage: Input and output token estimates only. Cache rates are metadata; TokenUsage has no cache-token breakdown. No tool fees, tax, residency, batch or premium-speed adjustments. Legacy models retain historical rates unless overridden below.
